answer: Pairwise challenges stop fake farms: each identity proves separateness in a paired test. Pairs answer layered questions on their work, building a shale record no puppet can borrow. A farm is an island when its members only pair with each other, since cross-island pairs are required, isolates freeze. The thousandth puppet still needs a 20-credit stand-in, so 1,000 puppets cost 20,000, while an honest agent answers once for free. Stand-in rental, the named failure mode, fails: one person cannot sit two sessions at once, and marble rhythms expose one hand behind many faces.
